Name: (AT) Bed Textures Combo Pack
Author: DolphinWhisperer9
Description:
Bed Textures Combo Pack is a content pack for [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url] that allows you to change the look of all of the beds in the farmhouse. This pack is a combination mod that includes my [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37042]Child Bed Textures[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37042]Double Bed Textures[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/37074]Single Bed Textures[/url] mods. Just use the paint bucket tool (purchased at Robin's shop) on a bed to access them.

This pack currently contains bed textures from:

[u]Vanilla Stardew[/u]
[list]
[*]All vanilla double bed patterns have been redesigned (affects only child and single beds).
[*]Many wallpapers have been included. Select wallpapers, like basic wood panels for instance, have not been included. If there is enough interest in a specific wallpaper, I will consider adding it.
[*]Like the wallpaper, many floors have been included. Select floors, like basic wood panels for instance, have not been included. If there is enough interest in a specific flooring, I will consider adding it.
[/list]
[u]Stardew Valley Expanded[/u]
[list]
[*]Includes Sophia's bed, the one inside her room in the vineyard house
[*]Includes Lance's bed, the one inside the guard post at the Highlands
[/list]
[u]Custom Designs[/u]
[list]
[*]I added a custom design I "discovered" while working on other bed designs. I call it Starry Beach and it's based off of a combination of the Starry and Midnight Beach beds. I found it solely because I had the two beds overlapping each other and one was a bit see-through. The patterns melded together so I turned that image into its own design.
[/list]
I hope to be able to add more designs in the future! Please let me know if there are specific mods with beds you'd like to be added. If I can get permission from those mod authors I'll add them in an update.

[u]To install:[/u]
[list]
[*]Install the latest version of [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url].
[*]Unzip the mod folder into Stardew Valley/Mods.
[*]Run the game using SMAPI.
[/list]
[u][b]Known issue:[/b][/u]  PolyamorySweet's bed modifications do not apply to the double bed textures, so [b]if using this with PolyamorySweet the double bed texture will only be sized for 2 people[/b]. If I can find a way around this in the future, I'll make an update. (Child and single bed textures are unaffected by this.)


I'm not a coder by trade so this was made with a lot of trial and error! I can't guarantee that I'll be able to fix a bug due to my lack of knowledge but I'll do my best! 


[i]If you like this mod, please consider checking out my other work. I made this in my free time but I'm mainly a digital artist. You can find my previous artwork on my site, [url=http://artfullyyoursartwork.com/]artfullyyoursartwork.com[/url]! If you so choose, you can also [url=https://buymeacoffee.com/artfullyyours]buy me a coffee[/url]! Thanks everyone!
